observations.fact: Package describes a semantic-force layout engine extracted from Fork Tales and an intended graph layout app consumer.

Pure numeric step mutates Particle arrays and clamps dt to [0.001,0.5]; isolated actual execution observes zero/negative elapsed time motion, NaN propagation and infinite dt treated as a bounded positive step.
Structural/semantic force passes feed mass-scaled integration, common per-step damping, recentering and hard boundary clamp; split-step fixture changes damping over an equal total interval.
Graph ants maintain in-memory pheromone/visit state, use Math.random for starts/resets/choices and evaporate once per tick; config has no explicit replay seed.
The app publishes semantic similarity samples with layout.v1/semantic_charge provenance, rather than publishing particle motion or collision state as that sample.
Simulation tick uses configured simDt subdivided by simSubsteps; optional ants become spring edges. Position writes send id,x,y to layout storage.

Selected graph memory route seeds from vectors, constructs adjacency from semantic samples/legacy edges/claims, then adjusts costs using decayed prior trails and time-varying noise. No position/velocity/collision input appears in this selected cost construction.

Traversed semantic edges are reinforced and default-enabled trails persisted within retrieval; persistDaimoiTrails=false controls trail persistence, not the separately executed semantic reinforcement.

derived_selection_requirements: Existing force math and persistence/query seams are concrete reuse candidates. Select one computation authority through the reviewed owner/numeric decision; a package name or donor claim does not supply promotion authority.

Separate layout geometry from semantic samples and graph-cost trails. Demonstrate that physical state and mood causally change authorized recall and choices rather than crediting a shared field/daimoi vocabulary.

Resolve actual elapsed time, zero/negative/nonfinite refusal, damping as time semantics, fixed ordering and explicit exploration seed in the selected numeric contract. Fixture constants are not proposed production parameters.

Preserve sparse environmental vector fields, differentiated entity friction, elastic intent bonds, collision exchange and immutable emitted ownership from the recovered design. The selected layout-only Particle/config/ant surface does not implement those character mechanics.

Separate memory retrieval observations from outcome-authorized reinforcement and enforce visibility before graph traversal and any feedback. Outer HTTP authorization was not audited; no vulnerability claim follows from route-local projection alone.
limits: No donor repository edits, graph app start, live graph query, package gate execution, database or social effect.
